Thūpavaṃsa
Bud. Pāli. by Vācissara Thera. chronicle, composed in Ceylon in 12th Cent. gives a. account of the Stūpas in India an. Ceylon. See Malalasekera, Pāli Lit. of Ceylon p.. 216-18.
Colombo p. 54. Colombo D. I. 2007. 2008. Fausböll 139. IO. Pāli p. 127 (no. 111 fr..). Paris Pāli p. 35.
(1) Ed. by Woeligama Dharmaratna, Colombo, 1897. (2) by B. C. Law, PTS. 1935. [Page288-a.
